Closed-loop self-improvement

LoopWAM turns real-world experience into better robot policies. By learning from successful, suboptimal, and failed rollouts alongside expert demonstrations, it closes the loop between deployment and improvement.

Method and key techniques

Joint video–action modeling

Video and action tokens interact through bidirectional attention throughout joint denoising.

Source-dependent noise

Lower-noise rollout actions guide video prediction to learn their observed physical consequences.

Quality-aware learning

Quality conditions and weights guide action learning. Every rollout teaches video prediction, without imitating failed actions.
